# ubiops_deployment_environment_variable (Resource)

Manages a deployment-level environment variable in UbiOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_deployment_environment_variable" "example" {
  project_name    = "my-project"
  deployment_name = "my-deployment"
  name            = "MODEL_PATH"
  value           = "/models/v1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_name` (String) The name of the deployment.
- `name` (String) Variable name
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value (will be null for secret variables)

### Optional

- `secret` (Boolean) Boolean that indicates if this variable contains sensitive information

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the environment variable

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_deployment_environment_variable.example my-project/my-deployment/env-var-uuid
```
